newsitem.title: USA: La. sweet crudes rebound, Postings Plus takes dive.
newsitem.headline: La. sweet crudes rebound, Postings Plus takes dive.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes Thursday featured a recovering Louisiana sweet market and sharply weaker March Postings Plus values due to a 25 cents decrease in the March/April West Texas Intermediate spread.
Front month NYMEX futures have plummeted on expiration day, finding selling pressure as players roll positions.
March WTI stood around 85 cts lower at $21.90-$22.00 a barrel, with the Mar/Apr WTI down to around 22-25 cts.
Mar Postings has moved down to around $2.05-10, after trading earlier in the session as firm as $2.28-29.
Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James held a 33-37 cts premium.
